purpose: Test whether explicit belief and two-ply planning materially improve high-skill social-deduction play before SCK is used as a narrative decision component.

results.scope: 6 players, discussion_rounds=3, seeds 0-499 shared across all four variants

belief_discrimination_diagnostic.meaning: In 74.1% of decisions every legal target had the SAME marginal Mafia probability, so the belief could not rank the targets and the tie-break alone chose the action. For Villager it is 100%.

results.conclusion: The direction is reproducible at 500 episodes with a verified identical role schedule and zero leakage, but the belief-discrimination diagnostic shows the improvement is NOT yet attributable to cognition: for Villager, Doctor and Detective the belief is provably unable to rank candidates, so the observed regret gains come from tie-break structure and from the planner changing which deterministic target is chosen. The protect-regret gain in particular is an artifact: both the Doctor's 'lowest marginal' rule and the Mafia's 'lowest marginal' rule collapse to 'lowest living id', so the Doctor often protects exactly the Mafia's target without any inference.
results.gate_decision: Do not add MCTS or bi-level search, and do not yet reconnect SCK to the risk-list hospital Scene. The next work item is to restore a real evidence channel (see next_channel_work), because the current benchmark cannot exercise the mechanism the gate is meant to test.

next_channel_work.environment_defect: textarena 0.7.4 broadcasts day votes as PLAYER_ACTION observations to every player, then strips the '[Player N]' role tag from those messages inside State.add_observation. The vote target is destroyed. The environment appears to intend votes to be public, so this is best read as an environment defect rather than a rule.
next_channel_work.candidate_fix: Run an explicitly labelled sensitivity arm in which the runner reconstructs the intended public vote record from the actions it submitted for the seats that already voted in the current round (sequential order preserved). Default must stay off so the primary numbers remain strictly within what the environment actually delivers.
next_channel_work.unused_helper_this_would_activate: recorded_vote_evidence in storybox_textarena_secret_mafia_adapter_v0.py is already implemented and unit-tested but is dead code in live play because no vote target is observable.

minimum_validity_conditions: All variants receive identical public/private observations for the same seed and role schedule.
Backstage truth is available only to the evaluator, never to the decision policy.
Discussion language generation is separated from strategic action in belief and belief_planning variants.
Role-conditioned results are reported because aggregate win rate can hide role imbalance.
A planning win claim requires lower action regret or higher win/utility without materially worse calibration/leakage, not merely more verbose reasoning.

requirements_status.fixed_model_version: not applicable, no model calls are made
requirements_status.fixed_prompts: not applicable, discussion uses a deterministic template renderer
requirements_status.shared_seeds: satisfied, the harness verifies the initial role schedule is identical across variants for every seed
requirements_status.cost_logging: wall-clock per variant recorded in each report; token cost not applicable
requirements_status.failure_replay_retention: satisfied in compact form, episode_records holds one record per episode

additional_blockers_found: The belief channel is inert: 74.1% of belief decisions had flat marginals, and 100% for Villager, so no belief-driven ranking was possible.
8- and 10-player counts from the environment block are still untested.
persuasion_delta and strategy_diversity remain unavailable without an LLM listener/embedding model.
resolved in this milestone: the random tie-break confound, which had made belief look worse than plain at 50 episodes; informed policies now break ties by lowest id.
